title: app-shell (Setup catalog editors): show History and Audit only to a caller the trail doors admit — objectstack#23546 narrows /meta history, audit and diff away from setup.access
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23546

**Origin:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#23546. The maintainer's ruling there (`6190477105`, Q1 → A1) narrows the trail doors and asks for this objectui companion in the same landing. Filed by objectstack `domain:cli` seat 2 (objectstack#22648) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01Q9PZ5Pzqcus4woVvTZwWNU`, per cross-repo rule 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

**One line:** in Setup's catalog item editors, the History and Audit actions are shown only to a caller that `GET /meta/:type/:name/history` and `/audit` admit after objectstack#23546: `system`, `studio.access` or `manage_metadata`. An organization admin under a wall, who holds `setup.access` only, no longer sees two buttons that answer 403.

## What objectstack#23546 changes (the server side)

- `GET /meta/:type/:name/history`, `/audit` and `/diff` stop admitting `setup.access`. They keep `system`, `studio.access` and `manage_metadata`.
- `GET /packages/:id/commits` keeps `system` and `studio.access`. No objectui organization-admin consumer of it was found.
- An organization admin (`setup.access`, no `studio.access`) goes from 200 to 403 on these doors, measured on a walled kernel (`os-dev-report` `6189071639` on objectstack#23546).

## Where objectui reads these doors (read at objectui `main` `d25585c`, not driven in a browser)

- **Setup's Access Control group** (Positions, Capabilities, Permission Sets) opens the metadata-admin editors under `setup.access`. Under a wall they are read-only (`useWalledCatalogReadOnly`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/catalog-scope.ts:136`; objectui#12183), not hidden.
- **`ResourceEditPage.tsx`:** the History sheet (`HistoryPanel`) and the Audit sheet (`AuditPanel.tsx:133`, `client.audit`) appear under `!createMode`, with no capability gate.
- **`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`:** the History button routes to `ResourceHistoryPage.tsx:162` (`client.history`), with no capability gate.

## Acceptance (a proposal; the lane's call)

- The History and Audit entries render only when the caller holds `studio.access` or `manage_metadata`, or is `system`. Read the caller's capabilities the way the app shell already gates other Studio-only actions; find that idiom rather than adding a new one.
- A Setup user with `setup.access` only sees neither entry, under a wall or not. A `studio.access` author sees both, as today.
- The pin bump follows through the repo's bump script, after objectstack#23546's PR lands, so that the server and the UI agree from one release.
